summary.answer: Reuse stopped common/character/preview/XP caller facts: several ZM-named children are constructed unconditionally in shared recovered source, so names alone do not exclude these calls. Difficulty image only selects the four-entry difficulty array for LAN zclassic outside offline custom; otherwise transparent. Localized map name has LAN tutorial/trial special cases then generic map fallback. Hide preview resets three widget paths to CoD.NOTHING, shown/info false and item fields empty/hash0. IsOfflineCustom compares initialized model to CUSTOM_GAME. Preview index getter conditionally resolves item name/desc/image, localizes xhash name and forwards info. Three show helpers select current map story, set respective widget path and shown true. Lobby-client subscription is added only if no saved subscription, rebuilding the ZM character list on membersChanged. IsDoubleNP excludes in-game tutorial, then checks native zombies event, else dvar>1. Its supplied XP-widget visibility also requires IsZombies/live, so that edge is only conditionally excluded given an original mode proof, not globally excluded here.
